comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (95.83%) to Smp24 L=K: 17%, G=S: 13%. Activity: active against E. coli JM109 (MIC 64 ug/ml), P.aeruginosa H085180216 (MIC 128 ug/ml), S. aureus SH1000 (MIC 32 ug/ml). MBC values are similar, indicating bactericidal. In vitro toxicity: human RBC: HC50 >512 ug/ml, not hemo.lytic. Structure: random coil in water but helical in 20-70% TFE
